values.note: 2026: full hookup 30-amp $45, large campers 50-amp $50 a night, up to 4 people (+$5 per extra person a night). Monthly 'temporary live-in' from Aug 1, 2026: $450 + metered electric or $500 unmetered.

booking.source: https://www.hollybluffcampground.com/rates ('reserve online anytime through Park With Us') + https://parkwith.us/camps/holly-bluff-campground ('If your RV is over 10 years old, please send a photo ... prior to your reservation'; minimum_bookable_nights 1), read 2026-10-22

note: Family campground (since 1968) on NC-49 southwest of Asheboro (Randolph Co), about 25 minutes from the NC Zoo; shady sites on a bluff with a trail down to the Uwharrie River; pool and arcade. Google 4.3 over 198 reviews (2026-10-01). --Claude
summary: Confirmed 2026 fees $45 (30A full hookup) to $50 (50A), 50-amp/water/sewer. Added 98 sites with pull-throughs, showers, wifi, dump, camp store, online booking via Park With Us. New site layout (rates at /rates, the old rates.html gone). Base $45 is under the US$50 gate (Park With Us's settings show a 6% guest service rate, which would make it about $47.70). Monthly 'temporary live-in' rates from Aug 2026; the share of sites on monthly terms is not published. Season not stated for the campground (only the bathhouse 'open year-round').
flags: Long-stay check (not a failure on the evidence): from August 1, 2026 the park sells 'Temporary Live-in Monthly Rates' ('Working a contract nearby, between homes, or just want to stay a while?') at $450 + electric / $500. Nightly rates are posted and bookable online, so test 2 passes; how many of the 98 sites are monthly is not published (test 4 unmeasured).
10-year rule (soft): the Park With Us booking page asks owners of RVs over 10 years old to send a photo before the reservation.
